---
title: "00 Run the Lab 5 project"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
editor: visual
---

Run the whole project from the raw files through both analyses.

```{r}
#| message: false

library(here)

parts <- c(
  "01_load.qmd",
  "02_clean.qmd",
  "03_augment.qmd",
  "04_describe.qmd",
  "05_analysis_1.qmd",
  "06_analysis_2.qmd"
)

for (part in parts) {
  status <- system2(
    "quarto",
    c("render", here("R", part))
  )
  if (!identical(status, 0L)) {
    stop("Render failed for ", part)
  }
}
```
